summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RCA and Audit Finding Management System. Backend APIs working well (94.4% success rate), frontend navigation and core features functional with minor UI issues.

minor_issues.issue: Create finding API expects risk_rating field but backend should calculate it automatically from severity and likelihood
minor_issues.impact: Finding creation fails with 422 validation error

ui_bugs.issue: Chart width/height calculation warnings in console
HTML validation warnings about span elements in tbody

integration_issues.issue: Modal overlay sometimes blocks navigation clicks
Matrix cell clicks don't always show selected findings

QA Manager login with demo credentials (qa.manager@aquaguard.com / password123)
Dashboard loads with all 4 KPI cards displaying sample data
Dashboard charts render (Department, Status, Risk, Audit Type)
Navigation to all main pages (Findings, CAPA, Risk Matrix, Evidence, Analytics)
Audit Findings page displays with table of 16 sample findings
Findings page filters and search functionality available
CAPA Management page loads and displays CAPAs
Risk Matrix displays 5x5 grid with 25 cells
